regime_context: The US thematic detector shows a narrowing rotation with 22/49 themes eligible via the absolute-trend gate. Cybersecurity leads as the confirming narrative (durability 0.82, breadth 1.0, crowded) but the rotation leader by raw score is Memory/HBM (eligible=false, durability 0.22), so the headline leadership is thin and not a clean handoff. The validated edge—drawdown avoidance via the trend gate—is intact (gate_helps=true), but track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.44, so directional conviction must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory, HBM & Storage regains trend-gate eligibility (it currently has durability_bar=0.22 and eligible=false despite the highest raw score). A move to eligible=true and durability_bar above ~0.5 would retire the view that the memory leadership is a thin, momentum-only artifact and not a real trend.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only theme combining trend-gate eligibility, high durability (0.82), full breadth (1.0), and a confirming val_state. The crowding flag (z=1.72) is a size-down caution, not a fade trigger per guardrails. The lean is an expression of trend persistence, not a return forecast.
evidence: crowding_z=1.72 (caution only, not a fading signal)
theses.dissent: Cyber is already crowded and the theme has an r10 of -0.0247, suggesting recent 10-day return is slightly negative; leadership may be peaking on attention rather than fresh flow.

falsifier.text: CIBR trails the S&P 500 by 5% over the next 30 trading days despite the trend gate remaining eligible.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software shows similar trend health to Cybersecurity (durability 0.77, breadth 0.857, trend gait) but ranks just below it, suggesting the software narrative is broader than the single cyber name. The trend-gate eligibility supports staying long rather than rotating out.
theses.dissent: The broader software complex is also crowded; if the AI-software trade resumes dominance, Non-AI Software could lag as capital rotates back into AI names.

falsifier.text: IGV lags CIBR by 3% over the next 30 trading days while both remain trend-eligible.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is trend-gate eligible with high breadth (0.909) and a durable trend structure (durability 0.7, mixed gait). It is crowded but the crowding flag is a sizing caution, not a directional signal. The lean reflects the absolute-trend gate keeping energy in the tradable set.
theses.dissent: Energy's mixed Hurst tag suggests the trend is less clean than software themes; mean-reversion risk is higher if the macro inflation narrative fades.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own 30-day trend gate and loses eligibility while the broader S&P 500 holds its trend.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
